1.0.0.title: Early release for testing and feedback
1.0.0.author: Markus Bordihn

categories.title: Features
list: Export the current project as Easy Model Entities Data Pack and Resource Pack files.
Preset auto-detection from bone names (humanoid, quadruped, aquatic, winged, arthropod, cuboid, floating, static).
Entity and Block Entity support.
Update exports for a single pack: re-export only the resource pack after model, texture or animation changes, or only the data pack after entity data changes.
Export into a mod project, or model-only for mod integrations.
Minecraft target versions 1.20.1, 1.21.1, 1.21.11, 26.1.2 and 26.2.
Optional advanced customization of dimensions, movement, behavior, attributes, rendering and animation.
Validation with blocking errors and performance budget warnings, including unusable texture locations and missing textures.

categories.title: Fixes
list: Fixed group names like " Head" or "Root" not being found. Case and spaces at the start or end no longer matter, like in the mod.
Fixed body parts in groups that are not exported counting as present.
Fixed the pack formats of Minecraft 26.2.
Fixed the model size and animation checks. The mod allows up to 64 clips, and clips like idle_2 or shoulder no longer cause warnings.
Fixed textures from other mods being written into the folder of that mod.
Fixed exports with schema version 0.1.0, invalid values or leftover settings of the previous preset.
Fixed lost dialog inputs after a blocked or cancelled export, and the export pairing being saved too early.
Fixed empty setting descriptions and the untranslated overwrite dialog.

categories.title: Changes
list: Requires Blockbench 5.0.0 or newer. The mod does not load model files from older versions.
Missing or misspelled body parts now block the export. A missing root group is fine, the mod adds it since 2.5.0.
Minecraft 1.21.1 is now the default target version.
Locators are no longer available in the Easy Model Entity format.
Project files only store export settings that differ from the preset, and no longer the export type. Older plugin versions use the preset defaults.

categories.title: Features
list: Minecraft target version 26.3.
New advanced settings for opacity, animation variants and their weights, and the shoulder position and scale of entities.
More checks in the export dialog and the status bar: parts the mod cannot load or ignores, groups or animations with the same name, and a changed target version.
"Wrap in root bone" button for cubes outside of a group.
Face UV rotation in 90° steps in the Easy Model Entity format, and back faces hidden in the preview of static models.
The exported readme names the minimum mod version and has sections for Easy NPC and troubleshooting.
